crew.overview: Following the death of the Leigh family matriarch, Annie and her children uncover disturbing secrets about their heritage. Their daily lives are not only impacted, but they also become entangled in a chilling fate from which they cannot escape, driving them to the brink of madness.
crew.title: Hereditary

details.biography: Despite her youthful shyness, Angella Joy began developing her love of the arts through Idaho theater and vocal performances. Angie was born in Logan, Utah on September 27,1963 to Robert Leon Webster, a forest ranger, and Donna Joy Webster,a homemaker. The eldest of 9 children, Angie learned hard work and responsibility by being raised in Idaho Falls, Idaho on a small goat and chicken farm. After graduating from high school, Angella returned to Utah to study business, fashion,interior design, and psychology. She has lived in Melbourne Australia and Milwaukee, Wisconsin and has 3 children. Her artistry spans an eclectic mix of sassy, professional, undercover, sexy, and mommy, beginning with her first Touched by an Angel appearance and many other commercial, film, and television roles. She has worked with celebrities such as Sharon Stone, Billy Zane, Treat Williams, Diane Keaton, Wynonna Judd, Marcia Cross, Anne Heche, Roma Downey, and many others. Since 1998, Angella Joy has been a single mother, business owner, teacher, actress, decorator, and musician.
details.name: Angella Joy
